intent.proves: At least one product carries an asset in a category that accepts pdf.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.DetailProductId) FROM EcomDetails d JOIN EcomDetailsGroup g ON g.EcomDetailsGroupId = d.DetailsGroupId WHERE g.DetailsGroupExtensions LIKE N'%pdf%'
